verses: Qayamat qareeb aa gaee aur chand phat gaya
Yeh agar koi moajza dekhtay hain to mun pher letay hain aur keh detay hain kay yeh pehlay say chala aata hua jadoo hai
Unhon ney jhutlaya aur apni khuwaishon ki pairwee ki aur her kaam thehray huye waqt per muqarrar hai
Yaqeenan unn kay pass woh khabren chuki hain jin mein dant dapat (ki naseehat) hai
Aur kamil aqal ki baat hai lekin unn darawni baaton ney bhi kuch faeedah na diya
Pus (aey nabi) tum unn say aeyraaz kero jiss din aik pukarney wala nagawaar cheez ki taraf pukaray ga
Yeh jhuki aankhon qabron say uss tarah nikal kharay hun gay kay goya woh phela hua taddi dil hai
Pukarney walay ki taraf dortay hun gay aur kafir kahen gay yeh din to boht sakht hai
Unn say pehlay qom Nooh ney bhi humaray banday ko jhutlaya tha aur yeh deewana batla ker jhirak diya gaya tha
Pus uss ney apney rab say dua ki kay mein bey bus hun to meri madad ker
Pus hum ney aasman kay darwazon ko zor kay meenh say khol diya
Aur zamin say chashmon ko jari ker diya pus uss kaam kay liye jo muqaddar kiya gaya tha (dono) pani jama ho gaye
Aur hum ney ussay takhton aur keelon wali (kashti) per sawar ker liya
Jo humari aankhon kay samney chal rahi thi. Badla uss ki taraf say jiss ka kufur kiya gaya tha
Aur be-shak hum ney uss waqiah ko nishani bana ker baqi rakha pus koi hai naseehat hasil kerney wala
Batao mera azab aur meri daraney wali baaten kaisi rahen?
Aur be-shak hum ney Quran ko samajhney kay liye aasan ker diya hai. Pus kiya koi naseehat hasil kerney wala hai?
Qom aad ney bhi jhutlaya pus kaisa hua mera azab aur meri daraney wali baaten
Hum ney unn per tez tund musalsal chalney wali hua, aik peham manhoos din mein bhej di
Jo logon ko utha utha ker dey patakhti thi, goya kay woh jarr say katey huye khajoor kay tanay hain
Pus kaisi rahi meri saza aur mera darana?
Yaqeenan hum ney Quran ko naseehat kay liye aasan ker diya hai, pus kiya hai koi naseehat hasil kerney wala?
Qom samood ney daraney walon ko jhutlaya
Aur kehney lagay kiya humen mein say aik shakhs ki hum farmanbardari kerney lagen? Tab to hum yaqeenan ghalati aur deewangi mein paray huye hun gay
Kiya humaray sab kay darmiyan sirf ussi per wahee utari gaee? Nahi balkay)yeh woh jhoota aur shekhi khor hai
Abb sab jaan len gay kul ko kay kaun jhoota aur shekhi khor tha?
Be-shak hum unn ki aazmaeesh kay liye oontni bhejen gay pus (aey saleh) to unn ka muntazir reh aur sabar ker
Haan unhen khabar ker dey kay pani unn mein taqseem shuda hai, her apni bari per hazir hoga
Unhon ney apney sathi ko awaz di jiss ney (oontni per) waar kiya aur (uss ki) kochen kaat den
Pus kyunker hua mera azab aur mera darana
Hum ney unn per aik cheekh bheji pus aisay ho gaye jaisay baar bananey walay ki rondhi hui ghaas
Aur hum ney naseehat kay liye Quran ko aasan ker diya hai pus kiya hai koi jo naseehat qabool keray
Qom Loot ney bhi daraney walon ki takzeeb ki
Be-shak hum ney unn per pathar barsaney wali hua bheji siwaye Loot (alaihi as-salam) kay ghar walon kay, unhen hum ney waqt-e-sahar kay waqt nijat dey di
Apney ehsan say her her shukar guzaar ko hum ussi tarah badla detay hain
Yaqeenan (Loot alaihi as-salam) ney unhen humari pakar say daraya tha lekin unhon ney daraney walon kay baray mein (shak o shuba)yeh aur) jhagra kiya
Aur unn (Loot alaihi as-salam) ko unn kay mehmanon kay baray mein phuslaya pus hum ney unn ki aankhen andhi ker den, (aur keh diya) mera azab aur mera darana chakho
Aur yaqeeni baat hai kay unhen subha saweray hi aik jagah pakarney walay muqarrara azab ney ghaarat ker diya
Pus meray azab aur meray darawey ka maza chakho
Aur yaqeenan hum ney Quran ko pind o waaz kay liye aasan ker diya hai. Pus kiya koi hai naseehat pakarney wala
Aur firaoniyon kay pass bhi daraney walay aaye
Unhon ney humari tamam nishaniyan jhutlayen pus hum ney unhen baray ghalib qavi pakarney walay ki tarah pakar liya
(aey qureshiyo!) kiya tumharay kafir unn kafiron say kuch behtar hain? Ya tumharay liye agli kitabon mein chutkara likha hua hai?
Ya yeh kehtay hain kay hum ghalba paney wali jamat hain
Unqareeb yeh jamat shikast di jayegi aur peeth dey ker bhagay gi
Balkay)yeh qayamat ki ghari unn kay waday kay waqt hai aur qayamat bari sakht aur kerwi cheez hai
Be-shak gunah gaar gumrahi mein aur azab mein hain
Jiss din woh apney mun kay bal aag mein ghaseetay jayen gay (aur unn say kaha jaye ga) dozakh ki aag lagney kay mazay chakho
Be-shak hum ney her cheez ko aik (muqarrara) andazay per peda kiya hai
Aur humara hukum sirf aik dafa (ka aik kalma) hi hota hai jaisay aankh ka jhapakna
Aur hum ney tum jaisay bohteron ko halak ker diya hai, pus koi hai naseehat lenay wala
Kuch unhon ney (aemaal) kiye hain sab nama aemaal mein likhay huye hain
(ussi tarah) her choti bari baat bhi likhi hui hai
Yaqeenan humara darr rakhney walay jannaton aur nehron mein hun gay
Raasti aur izzat ki bethak mein qudrat walay badshah kay pass
